verdict.rationale: The Marketing API documents creating a contact for an audience (docs-4) and is pitched as using custom data pulled from your app (docs-1). The rest of the story has no evidence: nothing documents updating contacts, suppressing or unsubscribing them in the Marketing API, defining custom properties or merge fields, or batch operations at production scale. The Transactional denylist/allowlist (docs-17) is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented contact update endpoint, marketing-contact suppression/unsubscribe via API, explicit custom property/merge field support, bulk/batch operations and rate limits for production scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
